summary:
Main
Futures, port and seaborne prices recovered together today while production eased. DCE most-traded closed at 682.0 yuan/mt, up 1.64%,and the 61%, 58% and 65% port indices rose to 656, 607 and 818 yuan/wmt. The seaborne indices reached USD 91.10/dmt for the 61% and 106.75 for the 65%, with all 12 brands higher.
